story.title: The ice cream
paragraphs_en: Maria is a girl that likes eating ice cream.
Her favorite ice cream flavor is vanilla.
But one day she ate more ice cream than usual.
One cup, Two Cups, Three Cups of ice cream !
Maria's mother comes over and tell's Maria
"Look Maria, I always tell you not to eat too much ice cream"
Maria says ,"Im sorry mom, but I love cream!"
Mom says, "Don't do this in the future!"
Maria drinks tea and feels better. Maria decides never to eat that much ice cream again.
